old_text:
Nobel Prize in Medicine goes to three scientists for research into brain activity
In short:
Two German and one US scientist have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine.
The prize went to scientists working on the mechanisms the brain uses to switch the activity of individual nerve cells on or off.
What's next?
The prize has kicked off Nobel week, with the physics, chemistry, literature, peace and economics prizes to come.
